aarch64-apple-darwin.rationale: First genuinely qualified release. Single 118 MB PIE binary plus headers and LICENSE dominate the payload; headroom covers minor upstream size drift without hiding a linking regression.

x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.rationale: First genuinely qualified Linux release. Single 130 MB musl PIE binary plus headers and LICENSE dominate the payload; headroom covers minor upstream size drift without hiding a linking regression.

comment: Compressed/installed size ceilings. First ceilings measured from the qualified macos release 2026-10-26 with ~27% headroom for upstream patch variance. CI fails on exceed; a human reviews whether the growth is justified.
